Adolescent ascension is a type of [[minor ascension]] where people increase in intelligence during their adolescence. It can lead to [[adolescent tripping]], and [[adolescent faustery]], so interventions are recommended to prevent such phenomena.

This makes adolescents more prone to engaging in [[juvenile delinquency]]
